notes: DELIBERATELY EASY control: renumbering REQ-157 forces an edit in every document that mentions the id, which is a literal lookup a grep answers exactly. Included so the doc set has a zero-advantage impact baseline. Document-only by construction — an id is a documentation artifact and appears nowhere in the code. Derived mechanically by scripts/derive-keys.ts from corpus/taskflow/docs/** using the same two conventions scripts/check-docs-corpus.ts enforces (a heading whose text starts with an id DEFINES it; a backticked src/tests/scripts path is a code citation); re-running it must reproduce this file. Paths are repo-relative to the corpus root. The aggregator documents traceability.md, glossary.md and every index.md are excluded from doc keys: they are generated from, or index, the whole corpus, so they cite nearly every id and path and would appear in every answer regardless of the question.
